name: A_same_trained_E2_residual_onoff
purpose: Verify implementation/update/inference chain and actual finite residual contribution; not E2 revival or new training

conditions.off: Same E2 trained original and added tensors; only aggregation.mode=off returns F unchanged

input: Same two frozen development clips 160x512x640 uint8, normalization85.0799/47.4845

inference.fusion: sigmoid per actual window raw logits, then pixelwise probability max

background.grid: reuse old local_tiles/global_tiles exactly, same pixel crop dimensions as target
background.exclusion: all annotation bboxes with2px margin using old crop_indices
background.ranking: published-checkpoint original fused logits; local and global maximum separately
background.missing: record missing; do not substitute; valid block count<20 retained as insufficient

logit_quantities: on/off at frozen release peak and at off peak; also on peak
region mean on/off and mean delta
region absolute-delta mean and fraction delta>0/<0
whole-frame and whole-clip pixel delta quantiles
logit_source: actual paired model forward values FP32; never invert probabilities; raw perwindow values persisted
on_result_reuse: Every new on probability map must be bitwise identical to cached old E2 map before cached scoring reuse; otherwise fail and review rather than silently reuse
residual: Capture actual output_projection(Wo*DeltaF) and preaggregation F; sum channel squares on nonoverlapping tile cores; per frozen region/window Frobenius norms; object equal aggregation over legal covering windows
matching: existing component peak/bbox one-to-one scorer unchanged, all validGT used for U, strictsmall for M
interpretation: logit or residual change not necessarily detection improvement
final E2 still subject to old U/background/protection requirements
training/posthoc ablation does not establish broad causal or temporal root cause
